name: Chia Seeds

pros.title: extreme water-binding fibre
pros.explanation: Chia is unusually good at turning a small amount into a thick, filling gel.

pros.title: ALA omega-3 is the headline fat
pros.explanation: The omega-3 number is the food-specific reason chia stands out among seeds.

pros.title: mineral density is genuinely strong
pros.explanation: Calcium, magnesium, iron, and zinc all help the seed case.

cons.title: works best with enough fluid
cons.explanation: Dry chia is not the easiest food unless it is soaked or mixed properly.

cons.title: phytates add an absorption caveat
cons.explanation: The mineral numbers are high, but not all of that is automatically absorbed.

cons.title: gel texture and digestion can be divisive
cons.explanation: The same gel quality that helps satiety can put some people off.
